reviews.comment: Dr. Simpson is a hard professor for a tough subject. You're graded on 5 homeworks and 2 tests. There is no extra credit, but there was a curve at the end. It's a tough class because she's not an amazing undergraduate professor, but I enjoyed it. If you like the material and are willing to work, take her! She can help you if you just ask! Use the TA
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The prof could've taught this class in a way that was easier to understand. The grading scale starts at a 91 for an A but she did curve it at the end of the year (which was very surprising). Even though lectures are recorded, going to class actually helps you understand better. She was an ok professor, but whenever I emailed her, she was cryptic.

This professor is obviously very smart, but she expects everyone else who doesn't even have a bachelor's yet to have the knowledge of a phD student. The grading scale is ridiculous- you only get an A if you have a 91 or higher. I stopped going to class and taught myself from the textbook and did better, may as well not have had a professor.

Hard grader and only goes over a small amount of examples for each given concept and if you don't understand them then basically you're out of luck. My TA this semester has only confused students further so our lab time was practically worthless. I would advise anyone taking 308 to try and find another professor.

This class is by far the worst POLS class I have ever taken and this is solely because of this professor. Offers zero extra credit, the grading scale is A 100-91, B 81-90, C 71-80. If half of the class fails the midterm she refuses a curve. The class consists of 5 problem sets worth 35%, two midterms each 15% and the final is 25%.

Game Theory was super difficult for me the grasp, as I'm sure it was for most of my classmates. Simpson isn't the greatest teacher out there, but she is super intelligent, and if you consistently show up to class, pay attention and engage with the material things will start to make sense, just not at first. 5 HW's and 2 tests.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: not the best prof out there. This class is hard and she does not really make it any easier to learn these hard topics. Does not really go in depth with how she got answers to problems, just expects us to follow along with her like we already know the stuff. 5 HW assignments a 50 min midterm and a final is all we are graded on use her as last resort
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Best thing about her was that she gave us 6 points on the final for wearing masks 100% of the year. Not the best prof. Doesnt seem interested in the teaching part of her job. Expected us to know everything the first go around. Game theory is extremely hard and it doesnt get easier when you have a difficult prof. A  91 B  81 C  71 like wtf?
